name: Coronado Commons
description: Coronado Commons is a boutique building of 41 residences in Coronado, Panamá, designed for life after sixty. Every home faces the view and opens onto a shared, garden-filled atrium.
disclaimer: Coronado Commons is a project in development. Images are artist's impressions and are illustrative only. Areas are approximate, include balconies and terraces, and may change during design development. Amenities and ground-floor uses marked "Planned" are part of the concept and not yet confirmed. Prices and availability are subject to change without notice. This website is not an offer or contract.
